Messages.Author: Dr. Enrique Montaño
Messages.Body:
it souns like a silly question but we have a doubt.

WwEF ans forced awakening new text is: Only usable by a tapped
vampire. This reacting vampire can use reaction cards and attempt to
block as though untapped until the current action is concluded.

It means that
A. if I use wake and block and the opposite vampire plays mirror
image. Can I still block with same vamp?

B. I use wake then misdirection or basic deflection, and the bleed is
redirected aganist me again, can I block or play another reaction card
(different of the first) with the same vamp?

Enrique

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <988915c.02010...@posting.google.com>,


The effects of both Wake and Forced last until the end of the action,
so in either case (A or B) the Woken minion remains able to attempt
to block and play reaction cards as if untapped.

gomi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Reaction cards' effects last for the duration of the action,
by default. (This default is explicit on Wakey.)
